notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes: Update 1.0.2

Fixed issues with the secondary objective (intercept convoy) in the Alternative history campaign 2nd operation:

  If you were to lose even 1 transport ship the remaining ones did not land the units (reward). Now you get a Core unit for every ship that reaches the allied Seaport successfully.  (2 Matilda tanks and 1 Hurricane fighter)
  If you eliminated Destroyers before capturing any Seaport, the ships would stop, and then they would not start moving to the Seaport you control when you capture one. Now, they start moving towards allied seaports.

notes.title: A massive missile strike against Ukraine - 10th October 2022 Dev update
notes.notes:
Hello

We are here today with an urgent report about the massive missile attack against cities all over Ukraine, including the capital Kyiv, where our team is located. This is how the day started for us:


Part of the team was already in the office, while other were getting ready to go to work or en route, when the first missiles hit Kyiv in the morning of October 10th. That was followed with several more rounds of attack. Overall, it was reported that 83 missiles of different types (43 shot down by AA defenses) and some kamikaze drones (some say 9 out of 10 destroyed by AA) were deployed in this attack. 

We decided that everyone could work from home, although some people were already at the office. That came in handy, as subway stopped for a few hours. 

As a person who lives in Kyiv my whole life and knows the city quite well, I can tell you that most places of the reported attacks does not make any sense in terms of military logic - its just some parks, squares or cars in the middle of the street, some tourist places as well. Nothing like an important military target, or even government building… The only explanation to that could be that the aim of these attacks is terror of civilians and an attempt to sow panic and chaos. 

Yet, some strikes did hit some power plants across the country, causing power shortages in several large cities (but not in Kyiv). Right now, I am writing this news update in my apartments in Kyiv, not knowing where the next Russian missiles would land…

Ukraine War Stories tells the story of the first month of the war. It would take more than one game to tell the story of this entire war… Still, if you want to know how everything started for the civilian people of Ukraine back in February - join us for the full release of our free title on 18 October 2022. 

The story of this war is far from over. Stand united, support Ukraine! 

With Best Regards from Kyiv
Oleksandr and the Starni Games team

notes.title: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release moved to 2023
notes.notes:
Hello

It is Oleksandr speaking. We have to move the release date for Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty to 2023. I am really sorry we could not deliver the game by the previously estimated date, but we had a lot of force majeure factors stacked against us, the key issue obviously being the War in Ukraine. 

We did not have a previous record of postponed releases and hope to avoid such incidents in the future as well. We value every community member, and we know that there are people waiting for the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release. Our key goal right now is to make sure we deliver a good game as promised, even if at a later date. 

The good news is, you do not have to worry about us abandoning the project, or something like that. We did have to stop working on it temporarily, but now the development process is being resumed. We still have to solve different complications as we go, such as gathering our VO cast in Kyiv despite the war, and so on. That is why we cannot name a specific date or month for the release yet - many things have to be considered. All we know is that the work is resumed, and it is in our best interests to finish the project as soon as we can without compromising on its quality. 

Another piece of good news is that our team is growing, allowing us to step up our production efforts. Right now we are more than 20 people. 

We plan to release a clear roadmap for the project in autumn 2022 and will provide monthly updates on our progress starting in October. We might have some good news in store for you still in 2022. 


In many aspects, the game was close to completion before the war started, but in terms of VO, cinematics, and localization the development is lagging behind, that is why we will need quite some time to catch up, as these are lengthy processes.

We hope for your understanding and patience and will do everything we can to deliver a well-made game that will take a proper place in the Strategic Mind saga. 

We will announce our Dev Q&A soon, where I will record a broadcast answering all of your questions about the team or any of our games. Feel free to ask us any questions you like, by filling this form:
https://forms.gle/mhoQ5wZdZFZSo2SX7

With best regards from Kyiv
Oleksandr and the Starni Games team

notes.title: PS4 Release, Community Vote Results and More
notes.notes:
General!

Our ever-vigilant intelligence service has prepared a news update, for your eyes only!
Here are all of our spy’s key findings.

Strategic Mind series is now available
on PS4

On August 5th Strategic Mind: The Pacific and Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg became available on the PS store. The PS porting and publishing on consoles is done by our partners from Poland - Klabater. Here is a tweet by the Klabater CEO Michał Gembicki:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31809087/1ddb98002716930ad3f2e3a9d9f5ed162772d983.png

We hope that the release on PS will be successful. As far as we are concerned the XBOX release will follow at a later date. 


Community Vote Results

Two weeks ago we announced the community vote for the historical tracks that would be created for the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty soundtrack. Now we are back with the results. We have carefully collected all the votes across Steam community hubs. We will list all the counted votes authors at the end of the post and we would like to give them a free copy of the Strategic Mind Franchise Soundtrack. Read more:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1474770/announcements/detail/2976301985164724802

New episode of Developer’s Gameplay is out!

Did you watch our latest episode of the Developer's gameplay series? This time it is the Battle of Dunkirk - the 3rd operation of the UK campaign. This is an operation like none the other - since you have to defend against overwhelming German force and allow for the Allied troops' organized evacuation by sea. Watch the latest Dev gameplay episode: 

[previewyoutube=LQr8E3fd7Fc;full][/previewyoutube]

New Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom gameplay on YouTube by Edmon
